descriptor.short_desc: Seth Sarai, Mehrauli, New Delhi, Delhi. The Qutb Minar, also spelled Qutub Minar and Qutab Minar, is a minaret and "victory tower" that forms part of the Qutb complex

descriptor.long_desc: This ticket grants entry to the Qutab Minar.

list.value: Expect the weather to be very cold, so pack winter clothes. Trekking shoes are a must, without a trekking shoe, you will not be allowed to participate in the trek. Also, carry 2 torches per person along with a spare battery
